{
  "settings": [
    {"name": "FORMAT", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`FORMAT` | Specifies the copy function to use. The default is selected from the file extension", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "auto", "default_evidence": "| `VARCHAR` | `auto` |"},
    {"name": "USE_TMP_FILE", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`USE_TMP_FILE` | Whether or not to write to a temporary file first if the original file exists (`target.csv.tmp`).", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "auto", "default_evidence": "| `BOOL` | `auto` |"},
    {"name": "OVERWRITE_OR_IGNORE", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`OVERWRITE_OR_IGNORE` | Whether or not to allow overwriting files if they already exist.", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "| `BOOL` | `false` |"},
    {"name": "OVERWRITE", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`OVERWRITE` | When `true`, all existing files inside targeted directories will be removed (not supported on remote filesystems).", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "| `BOOL` | `false` |"},
    {"name": "APPEND", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`APPEND` | When `true`, in the event a filename pattern is generated that already exists, the path will be regenerated to ensure no existing files are overwritten.", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "| `BOOL` | `false` |"},
    {"name": "FILENAME_PATTERN", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`FILENAME_PATTERN` | Set a pattern to use for the filename, can optionally contain `{uuid}` / `{uuidv4}` or `{uuidv7}`", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "auto", "default_evidence": "| `VARCHAR` | `auto` |"},
    {"name": "FILE_EXTENSION", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`FILE_EXTENSION` | Set the file extension that should be assigned to the generated file(s).", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "auto", "default_evidence": "| `VARCHAR` | `auto` |"},
    {"name": "PER_THREAD_OUTPUT", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`PER_THREAD_OUTPUT` | When `true`, the `COPY` command generates one file per thread, rather than one file in total.", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "| `BOOL` | `false` |"},
    {"name": "FILE_SIZE_BYTES", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`FILE_SIZE_BYTES` | If this parameter is set, the `COPY` process creates a directory which will contain the exported files.", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "(empty)", "default_evidence": "| `VARCHAR` or `BIGINT` | (empty) |"},
    {"name": "PARTITION_BY", "input_type": "VARCHAR[]", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`PARTITION_BY` | The columns to partition by using a Hive partitioning scheme", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "(empty)", "default_evidence": "| `VARCHAR[]` | (empty) |"},
    {"name": "PRESERVE_ORDER", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`PRESERVE_ORDER` | Whether or not to [preserve order]({% link docs/current/sql/dialect/order_preservation.md %}) during the copy operation.", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "(*)", "default_evidence": "| `BOOL`| (*) |"},
    {"name": "RETURN_FILES", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`RETURN_FILES` | Whether or not to include the created filepath(s) (as a `files VARCHAR[]` column) in the query result.", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "| `BOOL` | `false` |"},
    {"name": "RETURN_STATS", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`RETURN_STATS` | Whether or not to return the files and their column statistics that were written as part of the `COPY` statement.", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "| `BOOL`| `false` |"},
    {"name": "WRITE_PARTITION_COLUMNS", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "`WRITE_PARTITION_COLUMNS` | Whether or not to write partition columns into files.", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "| `BOOL` | `false` |"}
  ]
}
